title: My Red Cat
lines: I have a small red cat.
Her name is Mimi.
She likes to sleep on my bed.
Every morning she says meow to me.
I love my little red cat.

title: A Sunny Day
lines: Today is a sunny day.
The sky is blue and the sun is warm.
I go to the park with my friend.
We run and laugh on the green grass.
We are very happy.

title: My School
lines: My school is big and clean.
There are many classrooms and a library.
My teacher is kind and patient.
I read books and make new friends at school.
I like going to school every day.

title: The Little Dog
lines: A little dog is lost in the street.
He looks sad and hungry.
A boy gives him some water and bread.
The dog wags his tail to say thank you.
Now they are good friends.

title: Apple Tree
lines: We plant a small apple tree in spring.
We water it when the sun is hot.
In autumn the tree has red apples.
My mother makes a sweet apple pie.
The whole family enjoys the pie together.

title: My Family
lines: There are four people in my family.
My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher.
My sister and I go to the same school.
We eat dinner and talk about our day.
I feel warm and safe with my family.

title: Rainy Morning
lines: It is raining when I wake up in the morning.
The rain taps softly on the window.
I put on my yellow raincoat and boots.
On the way to school I see a small frog.
Rainy days can be quiet and beautiful too.

title: The Helpful Robot
lines: My uncle makes a small robot at home.
The robot can sweep the floor and sing songs.
It helps my grandma carry light things.
We teach it to say hello in English.
Technology can be a good friend to people.

title: A Trip to the Zoo
lines: Last Sunday our class visits the zoo.
We see tall giraffes and funny monkeys.
The panda eats bamboo slowly and looks cute.
Our teacher tells us to protect animals.
I learn a lot and want to come again.

title: My Dream
lines: When I grow up I want to be a pilot.
I will fly to many countries and see the world.
I will learn English well to talk with friends everywhere.
I will also help people who need a ride home.
I believe my dream can come true with hard work.
